note: The archive disambiguates same-named people two ways -- a letter suffix and a numeral -- and both are live in one dataset, so a reference written in one convention can name a record defined in the other. This states the correspondence where it can be DERIVED and refuses where it cannot. It does NOT rank the conventions and there is deliberately no `primary` field: the owner's ruling of 5 August was to publish the correspondence and not choose a winner, on the precedent of site/arda_aliases.json.
